body.name: I_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}
body.construction:
For distinct \(j,k\in\mathcal J\), let
\[
Q_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}
=\{q_j(\mathcal M)-q_k(\mathcal M):p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p),\ (G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\}.
\]
Define \(I_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}=\varnothing\) if \(Q_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}=\varnothing\), and otherwise define
\[
I_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}=[\min Q_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha},\max Q_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}].
\]
Both query coordinates are evaluated in the same SCM.
